case_number: 2024 INSC 289; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4615 OF 2023, CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4716 OF 2023
summary: Electoral non-disclosure of assets; ownership of dependent family members' vehicles; registration-based ownership standard per Motor Vehicles Act; failure to disclose electricity dues for prior government accommodation; incomplete tax liability disclosure; corrupt practice u/s 123(2) RP Act; nomination invalidity triggers election voidance u/s 100(1)(d)(i); substantiality of omission assessed via voter information rights; procedural compliance prioritized over materiality requirement; interim stay allowed candidate contesting fresh election; High Court finding of void election upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.100(1)(b)
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.100(1)(d)(i)
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.100(1)(d)(iv)
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.116A
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.116B(2)
Representation of the People Act, 1951 s.123(2)
Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961 Form No.26
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; High Court judgment set aside on tax disclosure issue; upheld on vehicle ownership and electricity dues; election declared void; respondent not declared elected due to lack of evidence against second candidate.
